text:
Ibrahim Noor: Idea — trial a 5-week "closure orbit" to tighten postmortem action follow-through. low-friction, role-driven, measurable.
Claire Park: "closure orbit" name is great. what's different from our previous pilots?
Ibrahim Noor: two things: (1) a short-lived rotation role called the helmsman that only owns postmortem runway (not incident command), (2) a fast timeline with an explicit long-tail check at day21 to catch slow churn.
Sam Hu: propose timeline: day1 ack, day4 unblock check, day10 focused close push, day21 final sweep or escalation. keeps cadence predictable.
Dmitri Volkov: helmsman duties: run day4 check, host an optional 20min "orbital pass" for active owners on Wednesdays, and trigger escalation at day10+ if blocked. helmsman rotates weekly.
ops-automator: automation note: "closure-orbit-v1" scheduled -> DM owner at day4 and day10; post escalation notice to #eng-oncall when helmsman flags >72h block.
Claire Park: also add a "streak" detector: if the same subsystem shows up 3+ times in a 45d window, mark it STREAK and automatically require a cross-team RCA follow-up.
Sam Hu: +1 on streaks. can we include a "streak severity" score (count * recency weight) so PMs know what to prioritize?
Ibrahim Noor: yes — keep it simple initially: streak_count and last_seen_ts. UI can sort by severity later.
Dmitri Volkov: communication rules: helmsman uses DMs for nudges. channel posts only for escalations with one-liner context. templates only. example DM: 
```
Hi <owner>, quick check on PM action #<id> — status? blockers? ETA to close?
```
Claire Park: add an optional single-sheet scoreboard for owners: owner | action id | created | due | status | streak_count | helmsman | notes. helmsman updates status column.
Sam Hu: metrics to capture during pilot: median days-to-close, % closed by day10, % closed by day21, streak_count delta, helmsman escalation rate. tracked weekly.
ops-automator: runbook uploaded -> /docs/incidents/closure-orbit-runbook.md
Ibrahim Noor: pilot scope: platform + infra teams for 5 weeks, opt-in owners. helmsman rota volunteers first; fallback to oncall lead if empty 48h before week start. escalation path: owner -> helmsman -> oncall lead -> eng director.
Dmitri Volkov: one procedural ask: helmsman should not change owners' wording or fix scope; only update status and surface blockers. keeps ownership clear.
Claire Park: action list: Ibrahim: draft runbook + signup; Sam: prototype streak detector (45d window) and severity; Dmitri: DM templates + orbital pass schedule; ops-automator: schedule reminders and wire scoreboard.
Sam Hu: i'll have a prototype script that emits a CSV with streak_count and last_seen by next Wed.
Dmitri Volkov: i'll post two DM templates and the orbital pass calendar invite.
Claire Park: i'll build the sheet and a tiny one-pager for owners.
Ibrahim Noor: pilot start Monday. keep comms very short in channel — only escalate lines. any objections?
Sam Hu: none. :+1:
Dmitri Volkov: :thumbsup:
Claire Park: signing up for week 1 helmsman slot.
Ibrahim Noor: thanks team — will post the signup link and runbook first thing tomorrow.
